content: Dinjii Chųų Teełtin Eeghaii Shranaazhik
Jii ąįįtł'ęę Jerusalem gwizhit Israel nąįį ch'ara'aa googwahtsii izhit Jesus gwats'ą' haazhii.
Izhit divii deek'it goo'aii geeghaih chųų dhakaii goo'aii, ąįį eelin zheh gwatsal ch'ihłoanli' goodlii; Hebrew ginjik zhit Bethzatha goozhii.
Ąįį zheh gwadąįį gwizhit iłts'ik lęįį nąįį k'igilt'aii, vandee kwaa, neehidik kwaa akwat vatthąį' iłchįį nąįį. (Chųų hee tł'ak eenjit nagogwal'in;
neegwiidhak hee K'eegwaadhat vizheekat gwich'in chųų zhit neediidhak ts'ą' chųų atł'ak gwahtsii. Juu tr'ookit iłts'ik chųų atł'ak zhit gwizhyahkhat t'ee veenjit gwinzii neegwiilik.).
Izhit dinjii ch'ihłak dhidii, 38 years łąą iłts'ik.
Jesus zhat k'ilt'aii niyiił'in ts'ą' niighyuk iłts'ik yaandaii; ts'ą' jyaa yahnyąą, “Sheenjit gwinzii neegooli' niindhan?”
Ąįį dinjii jyaa nyąą, “Juu chųų zhit shahahchyaa gaashandaii kwaa; chųų atł'ak dąį' gwizhit hihshyaa gwik'eegwihdaii gwiizhit sharahtee dinjii gwizhyahkhat geh'an.”
Jesus jyaa yahnyąą, “Ndak niindhat, nichyah oiinjii ts'ą' inkhaa.”
Izhit zhat ąįį dinjii veenjit gwinzii neekhwadlit gwagwahkhan dichyah oonjik ts'ą' ahaa (tr'iinzhii).Dak ninzhii ts'a' dichyah oonjik. Izhit Neegwaazhii Drin goo'aii,
ts'ą' Israel kįh dilk'ii nąįį ąįį dinjii shranaazhik jyaa agahnyąą, “Juk Neegwaazhii Drin t'oonchy'aa, dii-law zhit nichyah k'eehin'ak kwaa goo'aii gwinyąą.”
Jyaa gavahnyąą, “Ąįį dinjii sheenjit gwinzii neegwiłtsąįį jyaa shaiinyą', ‘Nichyah oiinjii ts'ą' inkhaa.’”
Jii giiyųąhkat, “Jii dinjii nichyah oiinjii ts'ą' inkhaa nahnyąą ąįį juu t'inchy'aa?”
Gaa ąįį dinjii shranaazhik ąįį juu t'inchy'aa yaandaii kwaa, tr'ihkhit dinjii gwanlii tee gwa'an gwiteiinzhii geh'an.

Ąįįtł'ęę gwandaa Jesus ąįį Kharigidiinjii Zheh Gwachoh gookwantee gwizhit yats'ą' tr'ineezhii ts'ą' jyaa yahnyąą, “Et'ee neenjit gwinzii akwat natr'agwaanduu akhagoiinyąą, ąįį akwaa ji' gwandaa nidivee gwiizųų gweheelyaa.”
Ąįį dinjii ąįį Jews kįh dilk'ii nąįį ts'ą' haazhii ts'ą' Jesus oozhii ąįį yats'ą' tr'iinjik gavaa gwaandak.
Gwidinji' Vik'iighai' Gwarandaii Tr'ihee'yaa
Izhit gwats'an t'ee Jews kįh dilk'ii nąįį Jesus tr'ookhwaa giindhan, Neegwaazhii Drin dinjii shrineiinlik geh'an.
Jesus jyaa gavahnyąą, “Shiti' khit gwitr'it t'agwah'in, ąįįts'ą' shįį chan gwitr'it t'agwał'in gwat'aałchy'aa.”

Jii jyaa diinyą' gwats'an t'ee łyaa geenjit tr'ookhwaa giiyuunyąą. Neegwaazhii Drin gwa-law łeełnaii gwizhrįh geenjit nakwaa gaa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Shiti' nyąą ts'ą' jyąhts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vagwahtsii veegoo'aii k'it t'inchy'aa geh'an.

Ąįįts'ą' Jesus jyaa gavahnyąą: “Łi'didlii haa nakhwaa gwahaldak, Gwidinji' duuyeh adakhai' k'eegwiichy'aa t'ii'in, Viti' dee'in gwąąh'in izhit gwizhrįh gwik'it t'ii'in. Gwiti' dee'in, Gwidinji' chan gwik'it t'ii'in t'oonchy'aa.
Gwiti', Didinji' eet'iindhan ts'ą' dee'in datthak yats'ą' googwaahch'in. Jii dinjii shrineiinlik ąįį gwandaa yats'ą' googwahahchy'aa t'avarahnyąą ts'ą' geegwaroolii kwaa lęįį nakhwandaa t'ihee'yaa.
Gwiti', dinjii niindhat nąįį ineegwahdaii. Izhit gwik'it Gwidinji' chan juu niindhan nąįį gwandaii intł'ineehee'aa t'avarahnyąą.
Gwiti' adan zhrįh dinjii eenjit k'eegwaadhat kwaa t'inchy'aa. Gaa Didinji' chan dinjii datthak eenjit k'eegwaadhat eenjit gwiłtsąįį,
Gwiti' deegwiłtł'oo tr'ihił'ee gwik'it Gwidinji' chan tr'ahah'aa eenjit. Juu Gwidinji' hił'ee kwaa t'ee Gwiti' yihił'e' ąįį chan hił'ee kwaa t'agwarahnyąą.

“Jii t'ee łi'didlii nakhwaa gwahaldak: Juu shiginjik diitth'ak ts'ą' juu shihił'e' k'injiighit ąįįt'ee gwandaii ndaanąą'ąį' kwaa hee'yaa. Ch'adąį' hee niindhat gwats'an neegwiindaii geh'an Ch'aroahkat Drin zhit ji' duuyeh an ilii.
Jii t'ee łi'didlii nakhwaa gwahaldak: khaiinjii zhat nigwiindhat, ch'adąį' hee zhat nigwiindhat, zhit juu niindhat nąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Vidinji' giheetth'ak ts'ą' juu yiitth'ak gweheendaii.
Gwiti' dinjii ineegwahdaii eenjit t'aih dii'įį, izhit gwik'it Vidinji' chan dinjii ineegwahahdaii eenjit t'aih intł'eiin'ąįį.
Ąįįts'ą' Vidinji' ąįį dinjii ts'ą' k'eegwahaadhat eenjit t'aih yintł'eiin'ąįį, Gwidinji' nilii geh'an.
Jii nakhwarahtee t'agǫǫnjyaa shrǫ'; zhat nigwiighit juu tth'ank'it gwizhit niindhat nąįį datthak nijin giiyeheetth'ak.
Nijin giiyiitth'ak ji' t'ee tth'ank'it khagiheedaa zhit juu gwinzii t'ee'ya' khaneegiheedaa ts'ą' neegwigweheendaii, zhit juu vigwitr'it gwiizųų nąįį chan, khaneegiheedaa ts'ą' goorahahkat.”
Juu Jesus Nilii ts'ą' Dee'in Yeeginkhii Nąįį

“Duuyeh shakhai' k'eegwiichy'aa t'ishi'in; Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa jyaa shahnyąą ji' gwizhrįh dinjii ts'ą' k'eegwahaldhat, shįį deegoochy'a' nihthan gwizhrįh gwik'it goo'aii kwaa gaa Shiti' shihił'e' ąįį deegoochy'a' niindhan izhit gwik'it goo'aii.
“Nijin ideenjit giihkhii dąį' zhit deihnyąą ąįį shats'an gwizhrįh t'igwinyąą kwaa.
Gaa zhit juu sheenjit ginkhii ts'ą' deeshahnyąą ąįį łi'didlii nilii gaashandaii.
Ąįį yihił'e' nąįį John ts'ą' nanoozhik ąįįts'ą' łi'didlii haa gavaa ginkhe'.
Dinjii andah t'iinyą' hįhjyaa gwat'aałchy'aa kwaa; neekhwazhii ji' eenjit gwizhrįh jyaa dihnyąą t'ihnyąą.
John adrii ts'ą' gach'ahdrii k'it t'inchy'aa, ch'ihłee gwizhrįh va'aadrii eet'oonghya'.

Gaa jii diihnyąą datthak John deiinyą' andaa gwihil'ee t'ihnyąą. Jidii gwitr'it t'agwał'in t'ee Shiti' geegwitr'it t'agoh'ya' shoonyąą shi'in, izhit deeshi'in gǫǫh'ya'! Gwik'iighai' t'ee Gwiti' shihił'e' gwigweheechy'aa.
Ąįįts'ą' Gwiti' shihił'e', ąįį nakhwandaa sheeginkhe'. Gwehkįį dohtth'ak kwaa, vinin gaa nǫh'in kwaa,
nakhwadrii zhit viginjik dhoh'ąįį chan kwaa, juu hił'e' ąįį k'injuhkhit kwaa geh'an.
Dęhtły'aa Choh kat aakin gǫǫ'įį, gwandaii ndaanąą'ąį' kwaa gaayiitr'ahaatsyaa nohthan geenjit. Ąįįt'ee vizhit shįį sheegirinkhii t'igwinyąą!
Ąįį googaa gwandaii khwa'yaa eenjit shįį shats'ą' hohjyaa kwaa.
“Dinjii shihił'ee akwat shihił'ee kwaa nąįį adan goots'an t'oonchy'aa.
Gaa shįį łyaa nakhwaashandaii; nakhwadrii zhit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa veenjit ch'eet'igwiniindhan khwa'įį kwaa.
Shiti' voozhri' zhit dząą gwats'ą' hoiizhii gaa shik'iinjuhkhit kwaa; gaa ch'izhii dinjii doozhri' zhit nakhwats'ą' neiinzhii ąįį vik'injahohkhit.
Nihłeenjit khadhoo'ee łyaa geet'ohthan, gaa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ch'ihłak zhrįh nilii ąįį hil'ee di'įį ąįį geenjit ninjich'ǫhthat kwaa. Jii kwaii jyaa dohchy'aa gwiizhit nats'ąą gwik'iinjuhohkhit?
Gwiti' vandah gwiizųų t'ahǫǫ'ya' nakhwahaihjyaa nohthan kwaa. Moses, vit'injyaahchy'aa ąįį jyaa t'ihee'yaa.
Moses łyaa vik'injuhkhit ji', shįį chan shik'iinjuhkhit haa nihk'it t'oonchy'aa, deenyąą t'ee shįį sheeginkhii t'inyąą.
Gaa deenaadąį' Moses deenyąą ts'ą' gwadąąntł'oo ąįį gwik'iinjuhkhit kwaa akwat gwiizhit nats'ąą shiginjik k'injihohkhit?”
